verdict.rationale: Codegen generates AI-driven insights from process data such as sandbox/setup logs (error diagnosis and suggested fixes) and PR diffs (change summaries, security/test-coverage checks), and exposes agent run logs for analyzing agent reasoning. However these insights are scoped to code/dev artifacts rather than general 'your data' (e.g. connected databases mentioned only as a connector, not as an insights source). Missing for 10: insight generation over arbitrary/business data sources (databases, docs) beyond code/CI artifacts, and independent/hands-on validation of insight quality.
